## Self-hosted fonts

DM Sans and Instrument Serif are distributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. The complete supplied notices, including copyright statements, are included with the font files:

- [DM Sans OFL](fonts/dmsans-OFL.txt) in the deployed app; source path `dist/fonts/dmsans-OFL.txt`.
- [Instrument Serif OFL](fonts/instrumentserif-OFL.txt) in the deployed app; source path `dist/fonts/instrumentserif-OFL.txt`.

`dist/fonts/sources.json` records their download origins and content hashes. The application serves these local assets and does not request Google Fonts at runtime.
